legal_units.title: Mode of repayment of certain loans or deposits or specified advances.
legal_units.text: For the purposes of this section, the expression "loan or deposit" means any loan or deposit of money which is repayable after notice or repayable after a period and, in the case of a person other than a company, includes loan or deposit of any nature.
